title: 2.3ft Portable Aluminum Folding Table, Indoor & Outdoor Lightweight Picnic Camping Desk, Wood Grain Foldable Table With Carry Handle
body_html:
2.3ft Portable Aluminum Folding Table, Indoor & Outdoor Lightweight Picnic Camping Desk, Wood Grain Foldable Table with Carry Handle

1.Perfect for camping, picnics, backyard gatherings, or indoor daily use, our aluminum folding table is your ideal outdoor companion!
2.Crafted with sturdy 16mm aluminum alloy frame and wood grain fiberboard tabletop, this lightweight 3.1kg table delivers solid 40kg load-bearing capacity, durable enough to withstand harsh outdoor weather and long-term use.
3.The smooth tabletop is effortless to wipe clean with a damp cloth. No complicated assembly needed—unfold and use in seconds! With a sleek wood grain finish, it looks elegant both inside your home and out in nature. When not in use, fold it flat with the built-in carry handle for easy transport and compact storage, great for carrying food, drinks and supplies during outdoor dining with friends and family.
4.Key Features
Heavy-duty aluminum frame, weather-resistant & longer service life
Smooth wood grain tabletop, quick wipe-clean surface
Fast unfold design, zero assembly required
Dual-use: suitable for indoor & outdoor camping, picnic, travel
Foldable flat with carry handle, ultra-portable
Stable structure holds up to 40kg
5.Specifications
Color: Wood grain tabletop
Material: Fiberboard Tabletop + 16mm Aluminum Alloy Tube Frame
Size: 70×50×60cm (27.56×19.69×23.62 inch)
Net Weight: 3.1kg / 6.83lbs
Max Load: 40kg / 88.18lbs
6.Package List
1 × Aluminum Folding Camping Table
